description: To check the trial app yourself, past the "Trial tool" page that visitors see first: a one-hour identifier for its address, tied to the trial key. Write cookie.value to the file named in file, then run the curl command (or the Playwright setting), which reads it from there: never in an argument. read_only: GET and HEAD only.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

name: open_trial_app
title: Open the trial app
